body:
## Summary

Draft snapshot of accumulated SMS harness work, originally published at `aea424cd6277b94a3073776c102615d20aca161f`, with follow-up formatting cleanup. The game-code work remains together in this draft.

Workflow and CI-tool improvements are separated into #162 for independent review. This draft contains no workflow changes relative to its original upstream base.

## Validation Status

The original GitHub Build job compiled successfully and uploaded the map and GMSJ01 progress-report artifacts. It failed afterward on strict symbol presence, order, and linkage validation in 31 source files. Building those same files at the upstream base reproduced strict failures in all 31.

There is also a source-level linkage issue introduced by this snapshot: the local `TTakeActor` replacement in `MarNameRefGen_MapObj.cpp` emits its destructor as global where the map expects weak. That source repair remains outstanding; #162 does not waive new symbol defects.

The 78 changed source files pass clang-format 21.1.8 locally. Declaration-macro formatting was adjusted without changing the expanded declarations. The old whole-tree lint workflow can still report an untouched upstream header until #162 is merged.

Full source review and PR validation remain pending. The live SMS worker checkout and process were not changed during CI preparation.
title: SMS decomp: current harness progress
